_provenance.title: Three-lever nociceptor threshold map (engine-generated reads + cited lever frame)
_provenance.engine_identity: gamma = -mean(NN stacking dG, SantaLucia 1998); R19 |h_sp| = 2(g/3)^1.5 = (2/3sqrt3) g^1.5 ; barrier = g^2/4 -- IDENTICAL to this package's inherited/vp_substrate.py spinodal()/barrier()
_provenance.reverify_note: every |h_sp| and barrier below re-derives bit-for-bit from gamma via THIS package's vp_substrate.spinodal/barrier (drift 0); see repro/_analgesic + the M-A1 gate
_provenance.firewall: READS the promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only. Not channel voltage, not potency, not dose, not in-vivo selectivity, not clinical effect (those are [O]). gamma is blind to on/off. L3 (NGF/CGRP) mechanism link is [O] — the read places the gene, it does not derive the receptor/network.

primitive: gamma = -mean(NN stacking dG, SantaLucia 1998); R19 |h_sp|=(2/3sqrt3)gamma^1.5, barrier=gamma^2/4
unifying_frame: analgesia = raise the nociceptor firing threshold |h_sp|, by ANY of three levers, selectively. v1.0's Na_V work is the L1 prototype; approved K_V7 (L2) and CGRP/NGF (L3) agents validate the other two directions.

levers.L1: reduce the inward (excitatory) current — block depolarising channels; removes the drive that crosses threshold
levers.L2: increase the outward (K+, inhibitory) current — open hyperpolarising channels; pulls V_m away from threshold
levers.L3: remove the up-stream sensitising drive — block the signal that LOWERED the threshold; restores the resting threshold
